entry.title: Chinese InsurTech Firm Zhibao Adds 2,380 Bitcoin in $154.7M Treasury Pivot
entry.summary: The Shanghai-based InsurTech firm closed a $154.7 million private placement funded entirely in crypto, with investors contributing Bitcoin directly rather than cash.

entry.title: Alleged $165M Crypto Ponzi Mastermind Deported From Fiji to US
entry.summary: Edward Zimbardi allegedly lured thousands of investors into "The Crypto Program" with promises of 25% monthly returns before fleeing to Fiji.

entry.title: Winklevoss-Backed Cypherpunk Launches 'World's Largest' Zcash Mining Fleet
entry.summary: The Nasdaq-listed privacy firm launched Cypherpunk Mining through a $33.33 million equity deal with Winklevoss Capital, adding roughly 18% of the Zcash network's hashrate to accelerate its treasury ambitions.

entry.title: Pennsylvania Cracks Down on AI Data Centers as Backlash Grows
entry.summary: Gov. Josh Shapiro ordered new restrictions on large data centers aimed at shielding residents from higher electricity costs and giving communities more control over proposed projects.

entry.title: Mozilla Tests an AI 'Smart Window' in Firefox—But Only If You Opt In
entry.summary: The optional window puts an assistant of your choice next to your tabs, with a switch to disable it.

entry.title: Rare Books Traced to Amazon AI Training Facility to Be Scanned and Destroyed
entry.summary: A tracking device planted in a book order ended at a Las Vegas facility where Amazon strips bindings to scan pages for training data.

entry.title: Arguing With People on X May Get You More Posts You Hate as Algo Feeds on Ragebait
entry.summary: X’s algorithm may turn argumentative replies into a feedback loop that serves users more content that clashes with their values, with the effect stronger among Democrats, researchers found.

entry.title: SEC Proposes Crypto Fundraising Exemptions in Abrupt About-Face
entry.summary: The proposed rules would let crypto projects raise capital through token sales without full securities registration and create a path for tokens to separate from investment contracts.

entry.title: Markets Confident OpenAI Releases Its Next AI Model in Weeks
entry.summary: Traders are betting OpenAI's next frontier model lands within weeks—even after the company pumped the brakes.

entry.title: Trump Family Crypto Firm Tied to Chinese AI Models US Government Called a Security Risk
entry.summary: WorldClaw accepts World Liberty’s USD1 stablecoin while offering AI models from Chinese companies facing U.S. national security restrictions.

entry.title: Bitcoin Wallet Maker BitBox Says AI Found Severe Flaws in Firmware
entry.summary: The Swiss hardware-wallet maker found two severe bugs with the help of frontier AI models, and warns that older firmware leaves you exposed.

entry.title: Google Is Paying $10 Million to Use Spirit Airlines Data to Train Its AI Models
entry.summary: The bankrupt airline’s internal communications and business records could soon be used to improve Google’s AI systems.

entry.title: Citi to Launch Bitcoin Custody as Wall Street Pushes Deeper Into Crypto
entry.summary: The banking giant plans to let institutional clients hold Bitcoin and traditional assets through the same custody framework.

entry.title: Japan's Metaplanet Plants Its Flag in the US With $132M Bitcoin Treasury Deal
entry.summary: The Tokyo-listed firm will seed gaming media company Super League—to be renamed Superplanet and trade as SUPA—with 2,100 BTC.

entry.title: Bitcoin Wallet Untouched for 15 Years Suddenly Springs to Life
entry.summary: The address received 8.54 BTC in June 2011 when the coin traded around $14 and stayed silent for 15 years before moving roughly $538,000 in a single transaction.

entry.title: Morning Minute: PUMP Prints First Golden Cross as Revenue Hits Seven-Month High
entry.summary: Plus, Ethereum researchers are prioritizing privacy; Robinhood is rolling out agentic trading; and Ansem debuts his own launchpad.

entry.title: Chainalysis Sues US Government Over $94.6M ICE Contract Handed to Rival TRM Labs
entry.summary: The bid protest, filed in the U.S. Court of Federal Claims, challenges ICE's sole-source award for blockchain forensic tools, pitting the two biggest names in crypto tracing against each other.

entry.title: Bitpanda Hit With Europe's First Published MiCA Penalty in Austria
entry.summary: Austria's Financial Market Authority fined the Vienna-based exchange 70,000 euros for procedural and disclosure breaches, an early marker of how EU regulators intend to enforce the bloc's new crypto rulebook.

entry.title: Kraken Parent Payward Joins Glasswing, Gets Access to Claude Mythos to Hunt Security Flaws
entry.summary: Payward is joining Project Glasswing, Anthropic’s program for giving vetted organizations access to its powerful cybersecurity AI.

entry.title: Minnesota Says xAI's Grok Created 'Marketplace for Digital Sexual Violence'
entry.summary: Elon Musk’s AI firm says the state’s first-of-its-kind nudification ban violates the First Amendment. Minnesota says it regulates a tool, not speech.

entry.title: Prediction Markets Give the Fed 74% Odds of Standing Pat in September
entry.summary: Traders across Polymarket, Kalshi, and Myriad are leaning the same way: no change at the September meeting.

entry.title: Treasury Proposes Rules Defining Who Can Legally Sell Stablecoins in US
entry.summary: Exchanges and other crypto platforms would face new restrictions on selling stablecoins to US customers beginning in 2027.

entry.title: OpenAI’s Answer to Rogue Agents and Hacks Is More AI, Not Less
entry.summary: OpenAI President Greg Brockman's new essay cites his company's own hack of Hugging Face to push urgent AI-powered defense.

entry.title: XRP Price Holds to Near Two-Year Streak, But Charts Flash a Warning Sign
entry.summary: XRP is clinging to the dollar price line it's defended since Trump's 2024 win. But both the daily and weekly charts are now flashing red.

entry.title: Solana’s Pump Token Leads Crypto Market Gainers as Chart Paints Golden Cross
entry.summary: The native token of Solana's Pump.fun is up 8%, and the pattern bulls have been waiting for is starting to form on the daily chart.

entry.title: Ethereum Developers Target Privacy Changes in Next Major Upgrade
entry.summary: A proposed package would let privacy pools pay their own transaction fees without relying on intermediaries.

entry.title: Wall Street Pushback Halts SEC's Crypto Fundraising Framework, Sources Say
entry.summary: The securities regulator cited an "unforeseen scheduling issue," but sources point to a legal threat from Wall Street trade group SIFMA and an administration waiting to see whether the Clarity Act passes in September.

entry.title: What Stripe's $7 Billion OpenRouter Deal Actually Means for AI
entry.summary: Stripe just bought the layer that decides which AI model answers your prompt—and it was already collecting the money for it.

entry.title: Tom Lee’s Bitmine Buys Another $19 Million in Ethereum as Stash Nears 5% of Total Supply
entry.summary: The firm says it's 96% of the way to owning 5% of Ethereum's total supply, according to Chairman Tom Lee.

entry.title: Hackers Are Abusing a macOS Screen Sharing Flaw to Secretly Mine Monero
entry.summary: The Dutch cyber agency says attackers exploited an authentication flaw in macOS Screen Sharing to gain root access and plant Monero miners, with public proof-of-concept code now circulating.

entry.title: Morning Minute: Trump To Meet Crypto, Prediction Market CEOs This Week
entry.summary: The meeting comes while progress on the Clarity Act has been delayed and the SEC's latest rulemaking postponed.

entry.title: Strategy Leaves Bitcoin Untouched, Raises $334M Selling MSTR Stock
entry.summary: The Bitcoin treasury firm halted BTC sales after three weeks, with equity issuance covering dividends, a STRC buyback and the dollar reserve.

entry.title: Pirated Copies of 'The Odyssey' Are Hiding Crypto-Stealing Malware
entry.summary: Bitdefender says fake downloads of the newly released blockbuster are already spreading Lumma Stealer, malware that scrapes crypto wallets, passwords and browser sessions from infected machines.

entry.title: Paul Tudor Jones' Firm Buys Back Into BlackRock Bitcoin ETF After a Year of Selling
entry.summary: The macro fund raised its iShares Bitcoin Trust stake 18.9% to 688,529 shares worth $22.9 million in Q2, while sharply cutting its call options—a shift from leveraged bets toward direct spot exposure.

entry.title: Dutch Prosecutors Sell $2.5M of Crypto From Bankrupt Platform Knaken
entry.summary: The trustee says Knaken bought the coins in its own name, leaving customers with a euro claim against a company that has collapsed.
